diagnosis: The export route passes req.body.patientId directly as an argument to an external CLI tool spawned via execa. The endpoint does not check if the requesting physician or staff member has an established clinical relationship with the patient. Any logged-in user can generate comprehensive medical summaries, diagnoses, and treatment histories of arbitrary patients.
